spec.description: Traffic, audience map, site health and maintenance

spec.title: Top 10 countries
spec.description: The ten countries with the most visitors over the last 30 days.

spec.title: Traffic sources
spec.description: Websites that sent visitors here over the last 30 days (search engines, social networks, other sites).

spec.title: Most viewed pages
spec.description: Pages with the most views over the last 30 days.

spec.title: Top cities
spec.description: Cities with the most visitors over the last 30 days.

spec.title: Browsers
spec.description: Share of visitors by web browser over the last 30 days. UNK means the browser could not be identified.

spec.title: Operating systems
spec.description: Share of visitors by operating system over the last 30 days. It also shows how many come from mobile (iOS, Android).

spec.title: Visitors today (live)
spec.description: Number of visitors so far today. It grows during the day and restarts at midnight.

spec.title: Site health score
spec.description: Quick health indicator out of 100. Starts at 100 and loses points for: WordPress core update pending (-25), each plugin update (-5), each theme update (-3), each late scheduled task (-10), debug mode on (-15), no HTTPS (-20), heavy autoloaded options over 1 MB (-10). Apply the pending updates to bring it back to 100.

spec.title: Updates waiting to be installed
spec.description: Plugins that have a newer version available. Updating them fixes bugs and security holes.

spec.title: WordPress version
spec.description: Version of WordPress currently installed.

spec.title: PHP version
spec.description: Version of PHP running the site. Keeping it recent improves speed and security.

spec.title: Core updates
spec.description: WordPress core versions waiting to be installed. 0 is what you want.

spec.title: Plugin updates
spec.description: Plugins with a newer version available.

spec.title: Theme updates
spec.description: Themes with a newer version available.

spec.title: Late scheduled tasks
spec.description: WordPress background tasks (backups, mails, publishing) that should have run more than 5 minutes ago. Should be 0.

spec.title: Debug mode
spec.description: WP_DEBUG should be off on a live site because it can reveal technical details to visitors.

spec.title: HTTPS
spec.description: Whether the site is served over a secure HTTPS connection.

spec.title: Published pages
spec.description: Number of published pages.

spec.title: Visitors today
spec.description: Unique visitors counted since midnight (site time zone). A visitor is counted once per day.

spec.title: Published posts
spec.description: Number of published blog posts.

spec.title: Media files
spec.description: Images, videos and documents in the media library.

spec.title: Database size
spec.description: Total size of the WordPress database.

spec.title: Autoloaded data
spec.description: Data WordPress loads on every single page view. Under 800 KB is healthy; above 2 MB it starts slowing the site down.

spec.title: Last content change
spec.description: When a published page or post was last edited.

spec.title: Content by type
spec.description: How the site content is split between pages, posts and media files.

spec.title: Pending updates over time
spec.description: How many updates were waiting at each moment. The line should drop to 0 after you update.

spec.title: Database size over time
spec.description: Growth of the database. A sudden jump may point to spam, logs or a misbehaving plugin.

spec.title: Autoloaded data over time
spec.description: Evolution of the data loaded on every page view. Keep it low for a fast site.

spec.title: Last 7 days
spec.description: Unique visitors per day, added up over the last 7 days including today.

spec.title: Last 30 days
spec.description: Unique visitors per day, added up over the last 30 days including today.

spec.title: Daily average
spec.description: Average number of visitors per day over the last 30 days.

spec.title: Today vs average
spec.description: Today's visitors compared with the 30-day daily average. 100% means a normal day. Early in the day this is naturally low.

spec.title: Countries reached
spec.description: Number of different countries that visited in the last 30 days.

spec.title: Where visitors come from (30 days)
spec.description: Heat map of the last 30 days of visitors. Each country is placed at its centre; the bigger and warmer the spot, the more visitors. Hover a bubble for the exact number.

spec.title: Wordpress
